decisions.reason: As a newly launched operator line with several models and its own webpage, it reflects visible investment and public commitment, so management is likely to continue rather than admit failure after only one year.

This niche garage-door variant appears less prominently committed than the flagship lines, but because it is still very new and fits the firm's customization strategy, management would more likely keep it for now.

Although it was only mentioned on the website and may overlap with the broader operator range, it is a recent launch in a core category, so disappointing early traction could still be treated as temporary.

This industrial door seems to have lower visible commitment than products given their own page, so it is somewhat more vulnerable, but as a fresh launch in the firm's established industrial offering it would likely be retained another year.

The insulated glazed industrial door supports the firm's compliance and performance positioning, and despite limited website prominence the firm is likely to persist because the product is new and strategically aligned.

Because it received a page of its own, this product carries stronger public commitment and likely higher sunk development and marketing effort, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
